scope: People sidebar routes visible to a user with all current People permissions

classification.existing: A dedicated screen, client call, API route, domain owner, and regression test already exist.
classification.extend: The existing end-to-end route remains authoritative but needs the behavior defined by the People v2 plan.
classification.new: Only the catalog state surface exists; a dedicated screen and end-to-end behavior are still required.
classification.provider-gated: The local workflow exists but completion requires external provider evidence.

inventory_semantics.route_variant: Static PeopleHome props plus a complete classified allow/exclude list define the route-reachable client surface.
inventory_semantics.renderer_import_graph_superset: All transitive HRX client imports owned by the mounted renderer; individual controls may narrow reachability.
